helper_cost_scope: Saved-only helper timing, not a full process total or scientific worker cost.
limitations: Saved-only reconciliation does not rerun the original independent GroundChecker, Graph, endpoint guards, scheduler or rollback.
Integer point reconstruction uses saved formula-code values, not an independently executed catalogue/licence derivation.
Full chosen-domain EOF lists are compared in entirety; this does not constitute a new full24 dynamic domain oracle.
Pending/direct-placement/temporary-exclusion fixtures remain nonlogical and not a complete master-conforming trajectory.
Repeated-Gamma, aliased MP ports, actual-zero marks and successful second-chain coverage remain unexercised; prospective native descriptor mutation requests also remain unrun.
Current checks qualify only controls on these two already checked contexts; scientific receiver/advice admission and matched searches remain separate.
review_scope: Whole saved JSON/raw source closure and numeric field/dependency consistency only; no scientific semantic replay.
